# Vendored Neovim colorschemes

The plugin directories here are third-party colorschemes carried verbatim. Same
rule as the Go vendor tree: report real defects as upstream issues, never as
in-repo patches. Style, structure, and lint findings in them are noise — skip
them.

`ATTRIBUTION.md` is the exception: VGS-authored, maintained here, mapping each
vendored dir to its upstream repo and license. Drift findings on it are wanted.
